correctness.rationale: For n>=3 all vertices are distinct and simple edges are checked. The normal-rung and deleted-rung fixed-state predicates are correctly encoded in 16-by-16 integer matrices T and B; row swap D implements the crossed seam. Every graph assignment corresponds bijectively to a trace term tr(T^(n-1)B D^delta). Entrywise exact multiplication establishes T^2(T^2-T-I)(T^6-I)=0; the eight exact starting traces n=3..10 then prove the claimed six-periodic Fibonacci formulas for all n>=3. Independent bitwise graph simulation confirms all 699008 configurations across n=3..9, and the matrix checker confirms values through 30. Intact cubic-ladder fixed minority is equivalent to majority full flip, and its Lucas-leading count gives the asymptotic denominator. Risks: matrix computations remain reproducible finite certificates, not hand-derived symbolic factorization; finite simulation is not itself an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The claim classifies fixed points on two specific one-rung-defective ladders. The closest known intact cubic-ladder full-flip majority census gives the reference asymptotic only: it uses three neighbor votes at every vertex and cannot imply the defective degree-two tie-retention test. published-finding corpus and literature searches on missing-rung minority fixed points, single-bond antiferromagnetic ladder defects and metastable-state census yielded no covering exact defect trace, six-periodic finite-size corrections, or three-over-square-root-five amplification. The full main PDF of Takata et al. (2016) could not be materially inspected, and an obscure published equivalent remains possible; priority is qualified, not absolute.

value.rationale: Single-edge perturbation of a natural Ising/anti-coordination ladder changes an infinite-family local-stability population by an order-one asymptotic factor 3/sqrt(5), consistently for two different topologies, with explicit bounded modular seam corrections. The perturbation inserts degree-two tie-retention conditions and is not a routine substitution into the intact cubic graph. Understanding exact defect susceptibility and all-size metastable counts is a natural structural invariant of these networks. This is local fixed-state counting only, not an unmotivated finite table or a claim about solver performance.
